site.ogDescription: Co-rheynn coadanyn jeih-rish-jeih troggit er çhaghteraght ny laghyn shoh neureenit. Cha nel server meanagh erbee. Cha nel un phoynt cailltyn erbee.

hero.subtitle: Sheelogh noa dy chorheynn coadanyn jeih-rish-jeih
hero.description: Troggit er çhaghteraght ny laghyn shoh neureenit. Cha nel server meanagh erbee. Cha nel un phoynt cailltyn erbee.

about.title: Mychione
about.intro: {project} t'eh ardan jeh'n sheelogh noa son corheynn coadanyn jeih-rish-jeih, troggit er çhaghteraght ny laghyn shoh neureenit. T'eh sheeyney enmys aashagh dy chleayn marish caghlaa neureenit slane, lhiggey lesh corheynn coadanyn shickyr as treisht heb feme er pooar veanagh. Ta'n çhamyr shoh open source, eeasit fo'n {license}.

decentralized.title: Eddyr-voggyl neureenit slane
decentralized.description: Cha nel server meanagh erbee, cha nel un phoynt cailltyn erbee. Ta ymmydeyryn feddyn as lhiggey-neose stoo dy jeeragh veih feallagh elley, gyn cliaghtey er ynnyd-rolley meanagh, jaghin chaghter ny stoyr-folkit.

accessControl.title: Reill kione goaill stiagh chiart
accessControl.description: Foddee dy chooilley pheiagh troggal eddyr-voggyl ec eh hene marish reillyn echey hene, gyn argid. Cheu sthie jeh dy chooilley eddyr-voggyl, ta keimyn ymmydeyr scarrit: shellooder, reireyder, chaglyder, mojderyr as eiyrtagh. Ta reill chiart ayd er quoi oddys foillsheydey, mojdershey as lhiggey-neose stoo.

ui.title: Enmys cleaynee feeu ard
ui.description: Enmys ynnyd-meanagh meanyn glen as tappee, cummit son boayrd-screeuee, televishan as ardanyn shooyl. Glen-hroailtys ny rieaughey marish lioar-screeuee, lugh, gamepad ny stiurader-foddey. Foddee ymmydeyryn vleeantyn ny prughtag y vroeashey myr server gyn kione trooid yn enmys linney-arrey.

dataFormat.title: Cummey-fysseree lhaihit liorish dooinney
dataFormat.description: Ta'n cummey-fysseree LISH troggit er JSON, ta jannoo eh aashagh dy yannoo, lhaih as toiggal. Co-rheynn dty stoo marish meta-vysseree glen as obbragh-jeeragh, oddys dagh duine cooney.

security.title: Preevaadjys as shickyrys
security.description: Ta dy chooilley cho-haarn jeih-rish-jeih cooylit, lhiggey lesh dty fysseree fuirraghtyn preevaadjagh er y raad. Foddee ymmydeyryn ceiltyn iad fo VPN son tooilley anenmnaghtys. Ta {project} cur arrym da dty phreevaadjys trooid co-aam.

crossPlatform.title: Y-ymmodee-ardan
crossPlatform.description: Ta'n prughtag goaillit son Windows, Linux as macOS. Jean ymmyd jeh er yn ardan share lhiat.

download.title: Lhiggey-neose
download.description: Faag {project} son dty ardan. Ta dy chooilley lhiggey-neose nastee as open source.

macos.title: Choyrlaght scanshoil son ymmydeyryn macOS:
macos.intro: Ta macOS Gatekeeper lhietalys jeskagh y phrughtaghyn gyn-jeerey/gyn-notaryssagh lhiggit-neose veih'n eddyr-voggyl, marish error {error}.

macos.exampleZip: Ny erreish da'n laghtyn-magh jeh ZIP:
